title: Chapter 47: I’m an Emotionless Killer
html:
“Good, because apprehending him is our responsibility.” Inspector Lee’s expression remained stern. “Do not take unnecessary risks.”

“Understood. My only concern is that if he realizes he has been identified and disappears again, I will never know when he might return.”

“The city investigation team has jurisdiction over the Ping An case, so the final plan will be coordinated with them. I will pass on what you have told me.” Inspector Lee packed away his laptop and stepped aside to make another call.

After the officers left, Uncle Xu came over, worry plain on his face. “Xiao Chen, I think you should listen to them and stay somewhere else for a few days.”

“I’ll follow whatever safety plan the police give me,” Chen Ge said. “Thanks, Uncle Xu.”

After one last look at the footage, he returned to the Haunted House.

Xu Wan was leaning against the gate. When she saw him coming back from security, she pointed to a boxed lunch on the table. “Boss, today is pork with green peppers. I may have convinced the canteen auntie to give you an extra scoop.”

Chen Ge thanked her and decided not to burden her with the details until he knew more. He ate quickly and resumed the afternoon shift. Xu Wan worked inside the Minghun scenario while Chen Ge sold tickets, his attention repeatedly drifting toward the park entrance.

Zhang Peng’s appearance is bad news, but at least now I know the threat is real and the police are watching for him.

The black phone’s missions had forced Chen Ge to become far more analytical under pressure than he had been a week earlier.

And then there is still the mirror entity inside the Haunted House. I cannot afford to forget one threat just because another has appeared.He sold tickets almost mechanically while turning the problem over in his mind.The attacks on He San and He Feng had followed a similar pattern. Whatever the entity wanted, it seemed to interfere with a victim’s consciousness. Chen Ge still had no idea what happened if that process went further—or whether the entity could become trapped away from a mirror.

It was an important question, but not one he was willing to test on an innocent person.

Zhang Peng’s return complicated everything. If the fugitive entered the Haunted House despite the police presence and encountered the mirror entity on his own, Chen Ge might finally learn more about both threats—but engineering such an encounter would be too dangerous.

For once, he resolved to let events and the police perimeter do the work instead of forcing an experiment.

Two threats under one roof. Wonderful.

At five, Chen Ge sent Xu Wan home early and told her not to return until he contacted her. Later, Inspector Lee called to confirm that officers were monitoring New Century Park and the surrounding area. Chen Ge closed the Haunted House, locked himself in the control room, and watched the camera feeds through the evening.

There are far too many blind spots. The new cameras cannot come soon enough.

The sun sank behind the park. Once darkness settled over New Century Park, the empty attractions took on an eerie stillness. Chen Ge stayed in the control room, the doll from his parents close at hand, waiting for either the police to call or the cameras to show movement.

Around midnight, the familiar scraping noise came from Murder by Midnight.

Is it trying to provoke me again?Chen Ge stood and considered investigating, then stopped himself.No. One problem at a time.

He returned to the monitors and kept watching.

Sometime after one in the morning, a bathroom door shifted on one of the feeds.

Someone is there.

Chen Ge leaned closer. A lanky man slipped into the Haunted House through the bathroom, moving cautiously and carrying something in one hand. Even in the poor image quality, Chen Ge recognized him.

Zhang Peng. He found another way inside.

Chen Ge remained in the locked control room and immediately messaged Inspector Lee. The room was well hidden, and someone unfamiliar with the Haunted House would have difficulty finding it quickly.

On the monitor, Zhang Peng moved down the corridor with his phone providing a weak light. He had no idea he was being watched.

After a long search through the maze-like interior, Zhang Peng reached the staff break room. He hesitated outside the door, visibly agitated, before finally forcing himself to enter.

He remained inside for less than a minute before reappearing. Whatever he had expected to find there, it had not been waiting for him.

His expression had changed from tense to furious.

A small stain marked one sleeve, apparently from an injury sustained in the dark room. He ignored it and moved deeper into the Haunted House.

Watching from the control room, Chen Ge sent Inspector Lee another update and stayed behind the locked door rather than confronting the intruder.

Zhang Peng passed the control room without noticing it and continued into the workers’ passage.

Where is he going?On another camera, Chen Ge saw him reach the sealed access to Murder by Midnight and force his way past the temporary barrier.

Why would he go in there?Chen Ge pulled off his headset and stared at the monitor.The scraping sound has been coming from that scenario. Does he think I’m the one making it?
